NOTICE
B.Tech/BCA Honours with Research – Eligibility and Guidelines
All concerned students of the B.Tech and BCA programmes are hereby informed about the provision for Honours with Research.
As per the B.Tech and BCA programme curriculum, completing a Project is a mandatory requirement for all students.
As recommended in the Departmental Council Meeting held on 5th August 2026, students fulfilling the prescribed academic criteria may be given an opportunity to opt for B.Tech/BCA Honours with Research, as applicable.
Eligibility and Requirements
Students who have secured an average GPA of 7.5 or above up to the end of the Third Year (Semester I to Semester VI) may be given an opportunity to opt for B.Tech/BCA Honours with Research. Eligible students may earn 4 additional credits by carrying out research work and successfully publishing at least one research paper in an indexed conference or journal during the entire Fourth Year. Eligible students whose research papers are accepted or published based on their research work may be considered for the award of B.Tech/BCA Honours with Research, as applicable.
Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)
1. Is the Project compulsory for every B.Tech/BCA student?
Yes. As per the curriculum, the Project is a mandatory component of the B.Tech and BCA degree programmes.
2. Who is eligible to opt for Honours with Research?
Students having an average GPA of 7.5 or above up to the end of Semester VI may be considered eligible to opt for B.Tech/BCA Honours with Research, subject to applicable academic rules.
3. Is Honours with Research compulsory for eligible students?
No. It is an additional academic opportunity for eligible students. The regular Project requirement remains mandatory for all students.
4. How many additional credits can be earned?
An eligible student may earn 4 additional credits through the prescribed research work for Honours with Research.
5. Is publication of a research paper compulsory?
For consideration for Honours with Research, the student is required to have at least one research paper accepted or published in an indexed conference or journal, subject to the applicable academic requirements.
6. Is acceptance of the paper sufficient, or must it already be published?
A research paper that is accepted or published, subject to verification and applicable academic requirements, may be considered.
7. Can any research paper be used for Honours with Research?
The paper should be based on the research work carried out by the student as part of the programme and should satisfy the prescribed academic and publication requirements.
8. Can a paper published before the Fourth Year be considered?
The requirement specifically relates to research work undertaken for Honours with Research during the prescribed programme period. Eligibility of any earlier work will be subject to verification and approval by the Department/University as per applicable rules.
9. Does having a GPA of 7.5 or above automatically give a student Honours with Research?
No. A GPA of 7.5 or above provides eligibility to be considered for opting for Honours with Research. The final award depends on successful completion of all prescribed requirements such as research publication.
